verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework, not an agent, so the official MCP server story applies. Mastra ships a first-party `@mastra/mcp-docs-server` package that serves its full documentation over MCP to Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex and other MCP clients, and the framework also lets developers author MCP servers that expose agents and tools. Missing for 10: the official server's scope is limited to documentation access (no evidence of runtime or project control), no setup or tool-list detail, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The `@mastra/mcp-docs-server` package provides direct local access to Mastra's full documentation via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It works with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex or any tool that supports MCP.
official MCP server documented at https://mastra.ai/reference/build-with-ai
Author Model Context Protocol servers, exposing agents, tools, and other structured resources via the MCP interface.
